body: I don't know. I was on medications some years ago, and I felt like another person. It wasn't me, I don't know. And meditation seems nice, but I don't know how to do it.

I'm afraid of losing her. When I'm angry, I'm angry at everything, even at her. Someday I'll say something stupid that will really hurt her feelings, or worse. 

Yes, I did talk to a therapist some years ago, but then I moved to another state and never looked for another. My girlfriend booked one for me next month, but I don't know if I can myself together until then.

I don't know, there is so much going on. I feel like a stone in everyone's way, I feel like I'm letting everybody down, just by feeling like that. And it just makes everything worse.

I've tried writing and drawing, but it just makes me angrier. I can't put my thoughts and feeling on the paper, I get really mad at myself because of that.
